name: Moe Moe Niji Taisen (Ryaku) 2 [Chu~♪]
source:
The adventure mode lets you experience a story inspired by real history, following the timeline of World War II and focusing on the weapons that made a difference in each operation.

Sometimes it's funny, sometimes it gets serious, and sometimes there are even heartwarming events?! Use the Steel Maiden Secret Encyclopedia to peek into the girls' daily lives! Check out your favorite Steel Maidens as much as you want! Not only can you uncover their secrets, but you might also score bonus points or secret weapons to power up your team in simulation mode. Use those bonus points to help your favorite girl level up! Tons of brand-new event CGs drawn just for the console version! And don't forget the classic "Damage Cut-Ins"-when your Steel Maidens take hits in battle and their HP drops, their armor peels off with dramatic cut-in scenes!

[Translated from [url=https://www.play-asia.com/moe-moe-2-ji-taisen-ryoku-2-chu-limited-edition/13/703lfq]play-asia[/url]]
